boundaryInterpretation.baselineFlatteningBoundaryPoints: pre-existing vertices of the adaptively flattened normalized silhouette; not introduced by fracture clipping
boundaryInterpretation.clippingArtifactBoundaryPoints: new exterior vertices which match neither a crack-boundary intersection nor a baseline flattened vertex
boundaryInterpretation.futureCurvePreservation: untouched exterior intervals can theoretically retain source cubics, but only after adding source-curve parameter provenance and splitting those curves at true crack intersections; the current polygonal pipeline intentionally lacks that provenance
boundaryInterpretation.requiredCrackBoundaryPoints: nodes where crack linework actually meets any normalized filled-silhouette boundary, including counter boundaries
